title: Friend dying on the moon

tellings.quote: There was a conversation I had with someone who I trust who got very emotional and described a friend of his dying on the moon.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist who reports on UFO claims, says that someone he trusts became very emotional while telling him about a friend who died on the moon. He told this on Jesse Michels's podcast in an episode about a hidden space programme. If true, it would mean people have been secretly sent to the moon, and some did not come back.
